feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 7 and its identical re-run in iteration 10 scored 303.8 with 14 of 20 oval completions, the best result so far, so I kept that platform and controller. Iteration 8 showed that a 12 mm footprint removes all oval completions (0 of 20, score 101.4), so the 16 mm footprint is required. Iteration 9 showed that the ±0.07 m span with unscaled weights also removes them (0 of 20, score 98.4), even though slalom line loss fell from 0.30 to 0.10. That means edge margin helps the slalom but the oval is sensitive to the span and weight scale together. Iteration 6 showed that a larger wheel radius cut oval progress (0.36 to 0.29), so speed is not the lever. Max_error has sat at 0.061 to 0.064 m for most geometries, while oval finishes reached 0.048, so the failures are sharp-bend losses rather than a general floor. Since this is the final iteration, no further geometry race follows. If the final unseen-track race is the outcome, the platform will behave as in iteration 7 on tracks similar to the oval. The s-bend and slalom have never produced progress above 0.5, so no geometry tested so far has moved them. Any future work should test the ±0.07 m span only with weights rescaled to about 0.86 times, and test wheel_track 0.11 m separately.
requested_changes: For any further iteration: keep sensor_size 0.016 m and the ±0.06 m span, since iteration 8 (12 mm) dropped oval completions from 14 of 20 to 0 of 20.

If a wider margin is needed for the slalom (iteration 9 cut line loss to 0.10 at ±0.07 m): rescale the weights to about 0.86 times the ±0.07 m values and test it alone, because the unscaled ±0.07 m run lost all oval completions.

If the s-bend and slalom still show no progress above 0.5: try wheel_track 0.11 m at 0.6 kg as a single change, since iteration 1 at 0.12 m gave the lowest oscillation (0.173) and no s-bend or slalom run has yet passed progress 0.3.
